netease.logoutConfirm: You will need to scan the QR code again to see your playlists. Downloaded tracks and local files are not affected.
netease.login: Sign in to NetEase Cloud Music
netease.loginTip: Scan the QR code with the NetEase Cloud Music app, then tap “Confirm” on your phone.
netease.loginExpiredHint: The QR code expired. Tap “Refresh” for a new one.
netease.loginRequired: Sign in to NetEase Cloud Music first
netease.syncEmpty: This account has no playlists yet
netease.importHint: Importing copies files into the target playlist. The NetEase download cache is never moved or deleted.
netease.mixtapeVaultCopyFailed: Copying into the mixtape library failed, so nothing was added. A mixtape never references the NetEase cache — clearing the cache once would break it.
netease.removeFromPlaylistConfirm: Remove {count} track(s) from the NetEase playlist “{title}”? Downloaded local files will not be deleted.
netease.removeFromPlaylistFailed: Could not remove tracks from the playlist
netease.removeFromPlaylistNotEditable: You can only remove tracks from playlists you created or from Liked Songs. Subscribed playlists and albums can't be changed.
netease.deletePlaylistConfirmOnly: Delete the NetEase playlist “{title}”? It has {count} track(s).
netease.deletePlaylistConfirmKeepLocal: Delete the NetEase playlist “{title}”? It has {count} track(s). Downloaded local files will be kept.
netease.deletePlaylistConfirmDeleteLocal: Delete the NetEase playlist “{title}”? It has {count} track(s). The {downloadedCount} downloaded file(s) that belong only to this playlist will also be moved to the recycle bin.
netease.unsubscribePlaylistConfirmKeepLocal: Unsubscribe from “{title}”? It has {count} track(s). Downloaded local files will be kept.
netease.unsubscribePlaylistConfirmDeleteLocal: Unsubscribe from “{title}”? It has {count} track(s). The {downloadedCount} downloaded file(s) that belong only to this playlist will also be moved to the recycle bin.
netease.deletePlaylistExclusiveDownloadedCount: {count} of them are downloaded and belong only to this playlist.
netease.streamOnlyNoFile: This track is still only in the NetEase playlist, so there is no local file. Export and analysis will download it automatically first. Download it before dragging a playlist track to the Filter or Curated library. NetEase tracks are copied, never moved. To delete the cache, download it first.
netease.streamOnlyDragHint: No local file yet — download it before dragging to the Filter or Curated library. Dropping onto a SET will download in the background.
netease.emptyDownloaded: Nothing downloaded yet. Importing a playlist downloads automatically, and single tracks can be downloaded from the row menu.
netease.emptyLibraryHint: Your playlists appear here after signing in and syncing
netease.orphanHint: These tracks are no longer in any playlist, but their local files remain. Clean them up when convenient.
netease.relogin: Sign in with a new QR code
netease.nothingDownloadedToDelete: None of the selected tracks has a local file yet, so there is nothing to delete. Download them first.
netease.deleteLocalConfirm: Delete {count} local files? They go to the recycle bin, playlists are untouched, and you can download them again anytime.

settings.qualityHint: Lossless is 16bit/44.1kHz. Master (jymaster) can reach 24bit/96kHz, requires a paid membership, and silently falls back to the best file available for that track.
settings.cacheHint: Audio buffered while previewing. Safe to clear at any time — unrelated to Downloaded.
settings.removePlaylistLocalFiles: Local files when removing or deleting a playlist
settings.removePlaylistLocalFilesHint: When you remove tracks from a playlist you created or from Liked Songs, or when you delete or unsubscribe a playlist, choose whether downloaded local files that belong only to that playlist also go to the recycle bin. You can also check “Remember this choice” in the confirmation dialog. The Delete key and multi-select use the same setting.
settings.showLibraryIconHint: When off, the NetEase Cloud Music icon is hidden from the left library rail. Sign-in state, downloaded tracks, and local files are unchanged, and you can turn it back on here at any time.

netease.importEstimateCopyNote: This is the size added to the destination library. A copy also remains in the NetEase library .store folder.
netease.copyHint: Copy the selected NetEase tracks into a local playlist. Tracks that are not downloaded yet will be downloaded first. The NetEase download cache is left unchanged.
netease.removeAfterCopy: Remove from the current NetEase playlist after copying
netease.removeAfterCopyHint: Only removes these tracks from this NetEase playlist. Downloaded local files are kept.
netease.compareFingerprint: Skip tracks that already exist in the fingerprint library
netease.compareFingerprintHint: If a track with the same fingerprint is already in your library, it will be skipped.
netease.copyFinishedWithRemove: Copied {count} track(s) and removed {removed} from the NetEase playlist
netease.copyFinishedWithSkipAndRemove: Copied {count} track(s), skipped {skipped}, and removed {removed} from the NetEase playlist
netease.removeFromPlaylistConfirmOnly: Remove {count} track(s) from the NetEase playlist “{title}”?
netease.removeFromPlaylistConfirmKeepLocal: Remove {count} track(s) from the NetEase playlist “{title}”? Downloaded local files will be kept.
netease.removeFromPlaylistConfirmDeleteLocal: Remove {count} track(s) from the NetEase playlist “{title}”? The {downloadedCount} downloaded local file(s) will also be moved to the recycle bin.
netease.removeFromPlaylistPrefHint: You can change this later in Settings under NetEase Cloud Music.
netease.removeFromPlaylistAlsoDeleteLocal: Also delete downloaded local files (they go to the recycle bin and can be downloaded again)
netease.removeFromPlaylistRememberChoice: Remember this choice (you can change it in Settings)
netease.hideLibraryIconConfirm: You can show it again in Settings, under NetEase Cloud Music. Hide the icon?
